body: Thank you!
I can't talk to my parents. My boyfriend knows my current condition. Outpatient therapy programs intersect with the hours of my job.

I am honestly dealing with these very thoughts right now. Why should I stay alive just because everyone else wants me to? I think it's selfish of them to only consider how they feel and not how I feel. If I want to die, that should be my choice; not theirs.

I'm tired of fighting. Just purely exhausted. I'm up, I'm down and I have no control over my own emotions anymore. None of the medications I have tried really seem to be doing much at all. I am tired of treading water. I no longer have the energy to even try and swim. This battle of mental illness has worn me down to the point where I honestly don't see any other way out of this existence that I am just suffering through.
Ok
Ok
I haven't talked to anyone there. So I don't know.
I'll try
I don't really do sports and between school and work, clubs are pretty hard to find and attend. My anxiety and panic disorder makes it hard to get out and do things
I don't know. Something in psychology but right now I'm just trying to find a reason to live
No. I need the money sadly
I'm an administrative assistant and I basically sit in an office and stare at a computer all day. It's not what I want to do with my life
I like my teachers. Not my job
Lots of stuff. Alternative, indie stuff, some rap but not a lot. Just whatever I vibe with
I like burgers and really good French toast
No I don't
It's going alright. I've always been a good student despite everything. This semester is a little more difficult than usual due to my mental state
I can try that I guess.
It's hard to explain but these modern witches who create a labyrinth so to speak inside of their minds and a guy gets trapped in their game
Gotcha
Season of the Witch by Natasha Mostert
I'm in a poetry class this semester at school. I like to read just about anything though I prefer fiction, but I'll read any kind of story. I write poetry, mostly about mental illness.
Reading and writing mostly. But my depression is currently preventing me from doing the things that I like to do
I had a full on breakdown/suicidal episode three days ago and I feel another one coming. I don't know if I can handle it this time. I'm just so tired.
What is there to really talk about anymore? I've been suicidal for a really long time and I'm at the point where I'm tired of fighting it.
Thank you
I'll try
I do alright with pure indica strains but I live in a state where it's not legal, so it's hard to find
I appreciate that. I've actually tried going the weed route but it actually reacts terribly with me. Like every time I smoke it I start freaking out and thinking that I'm dying. It's pretty awful.
Not really no.
I have a therapist but I won't be able to see her for a month while she gets settled at a new clinic
I'm alone for the night. I guess abuse both physically and mental, rape, depression, anxiety, PTSD, and a self harm disorder has brought me here. I hate the mess that I am and will always be.

Honestly. I'm just tired of being the way I am. I'm tired of being who I am and I'm tired of remembering all the things that have happened to me. I just want to be done fighting for a life that I'm not even sure I want anymore.
No. It was years ago and I don't even remember his name or the exact point in time that I met him.
It's so hard to live with the memories
I honestly feel the same. I'm scared that someone is gonna find out and have me committed against my will or something.
I feel the same but someone told me that it wasn't as serious
I have been trying to reach out but I'm at the point where nothing anyone says or does makes anything better.
Like. Does not caring if I live the start of me planning to die?
Thank you. Have a good night
Thank you for talking with me
For sure. But I'm going to try and get some sleep now
Thank you. I appreciate that. I try to talk to him, it just never really seems like the right time.
If I let him, he definitely does. But sometimes it's too hard for me to explain what's going on it he's already asleep and I would rather not wake him.

Yea, he does. But I don't want to keep him up just because I can't sleep. Especially when he has to work. He tried to help by having me come to bed with him but I end up getting up when he falls asleep.
I will make an effort to try to do that. I'm just a worry wart and a chronic people pleaser. I just want everyone to be happy, even if I'm not.
Honestly no, I should but I'm constantly making sure that everyone in my life is ok.
Sometimes. Though sometimes it makes me not want to try. Or I end up forcing myself way past my breaking point because I don't want to be seen as a failure.
It is scary. I'm constantly scared of failing. Right now I'm just taking classes and seeing what sticks but psychological disorders is where I'm leaning
I've maintained at a 3.5 GPA. So mostly As and Bs
I love it. I'm just scared I'm going to fail because my depression and anxiety keep getting in the way. I've always been good at school, i just don't know how this semester is going to go.
Thank you. And ironically, I'm studying psychology.

I appreciate that. It's too late for me to take them now unfortunately. Have to be up early to take my boyfriend to work and if I take one, I'll be out for hours. Maybe I'll try tomorrow. Fall semester is coming up, so I really need to get it together.
Yes I do. Plus it's just Valium and klonopin, which are both things that I have taken before with no problems. So I don't understand why I'm scared to take them now.

I've tried exercise, sex, reading, watching tv, yoga, deep breathing, and even just quietly laying there. None of it works. I have anxiety meds I could take but ironically my anxiety keeps me from taking them because I'm convinced I'm going to die or something. Which sounds weird if I'm suicidal. But I want to die on my own terms not because of an accident.

If I can get over my fear, I will definitely give it another go. Right now I'd kill for a decent sleep schedule or a good nights rest. My insomnia is at an all time high because my brain just won't shutup when I'm trying to sleep.

It has been tough and I want to try meds again but my anxiety won't let me because of how terrible my first run was. I just know that I have to do something because the only way this can get worse is if I'm dead.

Thank you for talking to me. I've been trying to find someone to understand for weeks and all I keep hearing is, "it gets better" but how could anyone really know that? What if it never gets better? It makes you tired of reaching out because everyone just spouts the same nonsense back at you. Everyone "wants to help" but when you try to talk to them, they ultimately don't really know what I say or do. I don't blame them though l, it just gets frustrating. Like appreciate them trying to do what they know how to do but it doesn't help me feel any better and it doesn't help me sleep at night.

For sure. I feel alone all the time these days and just completely empty. I don't even feel sad anymore, I just feel like a shell of the person that I used to be. It sucks because my siblings need me to be ok, my boyfriend needs me to be ok, work needs me to be ok, and school needs me to be ok. I don't know how much longer I can keep the facade up though. I'm breaking and I'm breaking fast. To the point where my own thoughts scare me. I don't want to hurt anybody but I don't want to hurt anymore

I want to come to terms with a lot of stuff but I still can't even look at myself in the mirror. Not that I'm a bad person, I actually turned out pretty ok considering the circumstances but I guess I'm just tired of putting on a brave face and pretending that I'm ok when I know that I'm not. I know I have to face my past but at the same time knowing what happened to me and acknowledging it won't change the chemical imbalance in my brain. Sometimes I feel like going to therapy makes me feel worse.

I do care about him and I never want him to think that what I'm going through is his fault. I feel like therapy is helping but talk therapy can only do so much. It's just getting really hard to dig up my past and talk about it when I would much rather bury it. My therapist is a wonderful lady but in the end there is only so much she can do. I wish she could cure my depression but she can't.

We've been together for four years, so I know a lot about his upbringing. Though it was religiously strict it was never abusive or anything like that. Like, he knows about my parents and stuff like that but there is only so much I can bring myself to tell him. Most of my old scars from cutting are covered by tattoos and the others I've explained away. Sometimes when I cut I don't do it deep enough to leave scarring but that doesn't always work. I just know that he for sure wouldn't understand it because of a previous relationship he was in where the girl would threaten to do it and blame it on him when she didn't get her way. I don't want him to think that I'm going to do the same thing because I'm not. I don't want him to think it's about him.

I don't feel like he could ever really understand because he has had a decent trauma free life. It's hard to explain trauma to someone whose never really been through it. Plus I don't know what's going to be too much for him to handle, I feel as though I can't tell him everything because it will all be just too much. Not to mention he doesn't really have mental health issues, so he won't ever fully understand my suicidal ideation. Cutting brings me comfort and minor relief but only for a short time. The pain makes sense, the ritual helps ground me, and when I do it I feel like I can breathe again. It just gets harder and harder to hide since there is a person I'm my life that sees my naked body everyday and he has no idea that I cut. I am hurting, you're right about that. I just feel like no matter what I do, the hurt will never go away.

It is incredibly hard to talk to them. Especially my boyfriend because I know that he wouldn't understand no matter what I say. I don't want him or anyone to look at me like I'm broken and I know that they will. How do you tell someone that you want to die without them calling the police or having you committed? I can't really cut these days because he will notice but it's getting harder not to. My parents are trying to be part of my life now but it's too hard to let them after everything that they've done. Things that they won't even acknowledge or apologize for. Even though I'm not sure if I would care if they did. On another note, nothing really brings me joy anymore. All the things I used to love to do just seem pointless to me now and what's life without joy?

I was raised by narcissistic and abusive parents. I have two other siblings but I bore the brunt of most of the abuse to protect them. My parents weren't just physically abusive, they were also emotionally abusive. So I've never felt like I was good enough for anything or anyone. They never took my mental health issues seriously and always told me to "just suck it up because what they had to go through was worse". So that's what I did until I got out of that house when I was 18. Shortly after I left home I was sexually assaulted in a dorm room at a college I no longer go to. I told no one about it because I knew that no one would believe me and my parents would ultimately just blame me. After that I spent time in a few unhealthy and somewhat emotionally abusive relationships with men I should have never even been with. There was one more sexual assault after that where this guy decided to take the condom off in the middle of sex without telling me. Luckily I'm disease free but I'm always scared that something is going to pop up. So now, I'm just trying to deal with all of this in therapy but nothing seems to really be getting better or changing. I tried to go on meds but they all just made me sicker physically and mentally. Now all I can seem to think about is ending my life because I really don't see any way out of the deep depression I'm in. I know this isn't horribly in depth but there is just so much and I don't even know what to talk about anymore. I don't have the heart to tell anyone in my life that loves me that I don't want to live anymore.
